title: 保護フードを開いた車輪バランサー
titleEn: Wheel balancing machine with raised guard
description: 整備工場のタイヤ作業背景に置く車輪バランサー。主軸と固定位置決め円すい・締付具、上げた厚みのある半円ガードと支点、十区画の空の重りトレー、無表示の操作ヘッド、背面サービス板と通気部を造形。タイヤを外す交換機とは用途が異なり、車輪は付属しません。一式1点で、回転・計測・校正・電装・安全性能は未実装・未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.308 × 1.437 × 0.831 m、7,516三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A wheel-balancer exterior for tyre-service workshop scenes. It has an exposed spindle with fixed locating cone/locking handle, raised thick curved guard and pivot, ten empty weight-tray compartments, blank control head, rear service panel and vents. Its balancing purpose differs from a tyre-removal machine; no wheel is included. The complete assembly counts once. Rotation, measurement, calibration, electrical behavior and safety performance are unimplemented and untested. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.308 × 1.437 × 0.831 m; 7,516 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
